name: hearth
description: Open-source community communication for Linux and Windows — servers, channels, DMs, and voice.
author: Hearth contributors

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @hearth/server
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @hearth/desktop
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && npm run pack:linux -w @hearth/desktop
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm run pack:win -w @hearth/desktop
